name: K-Fast Holding AB (publ)
summary: K-Fast Holding AB (publ) operates as a project development, construction, and property management company in Sweden. The company focuses primarily on rental housing properties in the Öresund region. Its property portfolio includes low-rise and lateral low-rise buildings, apartment blocks, and commercial properties. As of December 31, 2020, the company's property and project portfolio comprised of 7,496 apartments. K-Fast Holding AB (publ) was founded in 2010 and headquartered in Hässleholm, Sweden.
